headline: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water and Infrastructure Committee
meeting.summary: The committee voted 8–0 to recommend Resolution 26-137 as amended and discussed the Adopt a Street litter pilot program.
meeting.recap: The chair proposed correcting a resolution to say Parcel 11 is owned by a partnership and the United States Coast Guard.[[0:04:57]] Members voted 8–0 to make that amendment, with one member excused.[[0:07:24]] The resolution now goes to the full council.[[0:08:05]] The committee discussed the Public Works Adopt a Street pilot program, where volunteers pick up roadside litter.[[0:19:03]] The deputy director said the goal is to keep litter out of storm drains and the ocean.[[0:21:12]] Volunteer groups are asked to commit to two years, with at least two cleanups a year.[[0:21:23]] The program started in July 2024 on two streets in Kahului and Wailuku.[[0:22:54]] Interest was low for about a year, so the department expanded to other roads.[[0:23:15]] Three businesses now take part, covering two sections of Baldwin Avenue and one other road section.[[0:23:39]] One person testified by phone.[[0:25:12]] Underage volunteers need parent approval.[[0:30:06]] The deputy director said people can apply on the Stormwater Maui website.[[0:30:54]] Individuals can volunteer, and there is no minimum group size.[[0:31:06]] The deputy director said he needs to get actual numbers on litter collected.[[0:36:31]] The meeting adjourned at 3:20 p.m.[[0:39:07]]
meeting.next: The department agreed to provide a flyer members can share to promote the program. The deputy director said he needs to get actual numbers on litter collected at each event.
